description: This file defines the FIFOEntitlementConsumptionStrategyDao class, which handles database operations related to leave entitlement periods in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for updating leave period dates when changes occur and interacts with leave entitlement entities within a transactional context.

classes.name: FIFOEntitlementConsumptionStrategyDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object class responsible for managing leave entitlement periods with FIFO strategy, including handling changes to leave periods and updating entitlement records accordingly.

methods.name: handleLeavePeriodChange
methods.description: Updates leave entitlement periods in the database when the leave period dates are modified, handling current and future periods within a transaction to ensure data consistency.
